subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a session-owned multi-turn model lease contract for `/model --turns N`, and should that contract also shape the related one-turn override API?
rationale: The request adds public CLI/API/config and persistent model-routing semantics; the code can support it, but automation should not choose the product contract for turn counting, warning timing, auth-profile preservation, and overlap with one-turn overrides.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract
options.body: Define a maintainer-approved session lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway shape against that single contract.

options.title: Defer to one-turn API first
options.body: Keep this issue open but require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 to settle request-local model override semantics before multi-turn leases are designed.

options.title: Do not add native leases
options.body: Reject native turn leases and document manual `/model default` or operational policy as the supported cost-governance path.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract
recommendation.body: Define a maintainer-approved session lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway shape against that single contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on the existing session model override and Gateway patch paths that would own the lease contract.
